title.narrative: Cyber Security Support to the Pacific

description.narrative: The Cyber Security Support to the Pacific (CSSP) activity supports Pacific governments in the following areas: national cyber strategy development, security of infrastructure and data, cybersafety for citizens and businesses, and support to develop robust cybercrime legislation. The CSSP programme is NZ$10 million, comprised of the Cyber Security Support to the Pacific Activity (ACT-0101148) and the Computer Emergency Response Team New Zealand (CERT NZ) Support to Pacific Activity (ACT-0100498).
